title: Failsafe check
description: Finds where the control link would drop on the way out and checks what the failsafe then does: for return-to-home, the altitude it flies, terrain on the way, where control comes back and whether the battery lasts. A fixed-wing loiters instead of hovering, and on an autonomous route it reports whether the mission flies on and where the pilot can take over again.
author: rfmap
